title: mergus_events
description: One event of the `--json` output of a Mergus command (`contracts/events.md`). The fields that an event type requires besides the common ones are optional here and are checked by `mergus-contracts` before the event is emitted.

contract_version.description: The major version of the contract.

run_id.description: The identifier of the command run: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, not all zero (a W3C trace id).

sequence.description: The position of the event in the run, from 1, growing by 1.

timestamp.description: When the event was emitted: RFC 3339 in UTC with milliseconds and `Z`.

actor.description: Who started the command, for audit only.

command.description: The command that runs, such as `validate`.

arguments.description: The command-line arguments after the program name.

environment.description: The environment the command works on.

model.description: The model of the step or of the test.

engine.description: The engine that runs the step.

status.description: How the step, the test or the run ended.

rows.description: The number of rows the step wrote.

bytes.description: The number of bytes the step wrote.

duration_ms.description: How long the step or the run took, in milliseconds.

severity.description: Whether the diagnostic is an error or a warning.

location.description: Where the cause of the diagnostic is.

hint.description: One sentence that says what to do next.

next.description: Command-line invocations that address the diagnostic; never run automatically.

items.description: One invocation, as a list of arguments.

test.description: The name of the test or check.

failing_rows.description: The number of rows that fail the test.

manifest_id.description: The manifest the pointer now names.

exit_code.description: The exit code of the command (`contracts/events.md` section 2).

retryable.description: Whether running the command again may succeed, as the exit code table states.

on_behalf_of.description: The identifier of the person an agent or a service acts for.

location.description: A place in a project file.

file.description: The path of the file, relative to the project root, with `/`.
